answers.reason: The president chairs the central bodies of the university.
The president leads the university leadership which sets the frame and budget.
The appointment committee is a faculty-level or specific body, and members do not sit in bodies dealing with other kinds of questions.
The president leads the whole university rather than a specific faculty council.
Study commissions handle specific faculty matters outside the president's central role.
Examination boards handle specific matters where members take part only in their designated place.
Internal research funding rounds are handled locally within faculties.
Module revisions belong to specific degree programme working groups.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled by specific groups outside the central leadership.
Orientation week planning is a specific local body.
